narrative.overview: Tyohar AI unites the nocturnal grandeur of Indian ceremonial celebrations with the disciplined density of modern executive developer tools. It operates in the space where sacred family warmth meets uncompromising logistical and mathematical rigor. The visual world is defined by deep obsidian surfaces (#09090b), soft glassmorphic panels, and the warm glow of sacred saffron, gulal rose, and starlight slate.
keyCharacteristics: Nocturnal Obsidian Architecture (#09090b canvas layered with #121216 cards)
Sacred Chromatic Accents (Saffron Gold #F59E0B, Gulal Rose #F43F5E, Utsav Emerald #10B981)
Tri-Typographic Discipline (Playfair Display, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono)
Tactile Luminous Interactivity (Spotlight cards, spring physics, smooth counter interpolation)

rules.name: The Sacred Saffron Rule
rules.body: Saffron Gold (#F59E0B) is strictly reserved for primary actions, positive fiscal shagun savings, and key AI insights. It covers <=10% of any viewport to preserve its ceremonial gravitas.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: All numerical currency amounts, guest counts, and plate estimates must use JetBrains Mono with enabled tabular numbers (tnum) to eliminate layout jitter.

rules.name: The Border-First Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elevation is defined primarily by border luminance and surface tonal steps, never by dark drop-shadows on dark backgrounds.

dos: Do wrap large currency amounts and plate counters in AnimatedCurrency and AnimatedNumber so financial adjustments roll smoothly.
Do explicitly badge all unverified estimates with 'Estimated Market Benchmark (Unconfirmed)'.
Do conceal maximum budget ceilings from vendor negotiation drafts generated in the WhatsApp RFQ studio.
Do ensure every interactive card provides keyboard accessibility and clear visual focus rings.
Do render print-friendly high-contrast black-on-white styles (@media print) for official execution briefs.
donts: Don't use pure solid white (#FFFFFF) for large background surfaces in dark mode; maintain the #09090b obsidian hierarchy.
Don't deploy Saffron Gold (#F59E0B) as an all-over background fill; it is an accent of ceremonial rarity.
Don't format INR currency values without the Rupee symbol (₹) and standard Indian locale groupings (1,00,000).
Don't trigger destructive or irreversible state resets when running 'What-If' mutations; always diff and update in-place.
Don't hardcode external API credentials anywhere in client code; enforce session-isolated BYOK.
